difficulty_why: Linear allows any workspace admin to create a public OAuth application for free without review or approval, and users from any workspace can authorize it immediately.

dev_time.label: 15-30 min
dev_time.text: Registering an OAuth app in Linear's workspace settings, configuring the redirect URI, and obtaining client credentials takes about 15 to 30 minutes.

launch_time.label: Same day
launch_time.text: Public distribution takes effect immediately upon creation, allowing any external Linear customer to authorize the integration without review delays.

own_app_reasons.label: Custom branding
own_app_reasons.text: Displays your application's custom name, developer name, and logo on the Linear OAuth consent screen instead of Composio.

own_app_reasons.label: Dedicated rate limits
own_app_reasons.text: Provides dedicated API rate limits (5,000 requests and 2,000,000 complexity points per hour) independent of shared integration pools.

own_app_reasons.label: Webhook management
own_app_reasons.text: Enables configuring custom webhook endpoints to receive real-time updates for issue and comment events directly.

app_type.label: Public OAuth Application
app_type.text: Create a Public OAuth application with distribution set to 'Public'. This allows users from any external Linear workspace to authorize and connect their accounts, whereas private applications are restricted to the developer's own workspace.

prerequisites.label: Workspace admin role
prerequisites.text: You must have the Admin role in your Linear workspace to access Settings > Administration > API and create OAuth applications.

prerequisites.label: Standard Linear account
prerequisites.text: No paid subscription tier or special developer account is required; any workspace admin on a standard or free account can create applications.

prerequisites.label: Dedicated workspace recommendation
prerequisites.text: Linear recommends creating a separate, dedicated workspace to manage the OAuth application so other workspace admins do not have access to production credentials.

steps.label: Navigate to API settings
steps.text: Log in to Linear and navigate to Settings > Administration > API.

steps.label: Open application creation form
steps.text: Under the OAuth Applications section, click 'Create application'.

steps.label: Configure application details
steps.text: Set the distribution to Public, enter the application and developer details, and add the Composio redirect URI.

fields.label: Distribution
fields.value: Public (allows users from other Linear workspaces to authorize)

steps.label: Create application and copy credentials
steps.text: Click 'Create' to register the application, then copy the generated Client ID and Client Secret.

steps.label: Authorize users
steps.text: Direct users to Linear's OAuth authorization URL with the required scopes and redirect URI.

scopes.label: read
scopes.text: Default scope granting read access to the user's account without triggering review.

scopes.label: write
scopes.text: Grants broad write access to create and modify workspace data without triggering review.

scopes.label: issues:create
scopes.text: Allows creating and updating issues and attachments without triggering review.

scopes.label: comments:create
scopes.text: Allows creating new issue comments without triggering review.

scopes.label: admin
scopes.text: Grants administrative workspace access without triggering review, but disallowed for actor=app requests.

scopes.label: timeSchedule:write
scopes.text: Allows creating and modifying time schedules without triggering review.

approval.label: When required
approval.text: OAuth app review and directory approval are only required if you want your app listed in Linear's public Integration Directory; unreviewed OAuth apps can be authorized and used immediately by external workspaces.

approval.label: What's checked
approval.text: Linear reviews whether integrations are built by formal companies, useful to the community, and supplied with designated color/monochrome icons and showcase graphics.

approval.label: Wait
approval.text: Linear does not publish an official review turnaround time or SLA for Integration Directory submissions.

approval.label: Cost
approval.text: Creating OAuth apps and submitting to the Integration Directory is free with no developer listing fees or paid plan paywalls documented.

approval.label: Common rejections
approval.text: Linear explicitly rejects scripts, low-effort or 'vibe coded' apps, and tools built by hobbyists rather than formal companies.

approval.label: Before approval
approval.text: Unlisted and unreviewed apps have no install caps or test user caps and receive the standard OAuth rate limit of 5,000 requests and 2,000,000 complexity points per hour.

pitfalls.label: App name restrictions
pitfalls.text: The application name must be between 2 and 80 characters and cannot contain the word 'Linear' or protocol strings like 'http://' or 'https://'.

pitfalls.label: Workspace admin role required
pitfalls.text: Only workspace Admins can access Settings > Administration > API to create, view, or manage OAuth applications. Non-admin members cannot access this section.

pitfalls.label: Admin exposure in shared workspaces
pitfalls.text: All workspace admins have access to view, edit, and rotate OAuth application secrets. Linear recommends using a dedicated workspace to manage the OAuth app.

pitfalls.label: Token expiration handling
pitfalls.text: Linear access tokens expire in 24 hours (86,399 seconds), requiring a refresh flow at https://api.linear.app/oauth/token. Refresh tokens have a 30-minute replay grace period.

pitfalls.label: Admin scope restriction for apps
pitfalls.text: The admin scope cannot be requested when using actor=app authorization for bots or agent integrations.

support.label: Linear Community Slack
support.text: Post technical questions in the #api channel of Linear's official Slack community.

support.label: Integrations team email
support.text: Contact integrations@linear.app for questions regarding integration listings and directory submissions.

support.label: Linear Developer Documentation
support.text: Access official API, OAuth 2.0, and manifest guides at developers.linear.app and linear.app/developers.

email_subject: OAuth app verification and integration directory requirements for [App Name]
email_body:
Hi Linear Developer Support Team,

I am building [App Name] ([App Website]), an integration that allows teams to connect their Linear accounts to our AI agent platform using OAuth 2.0.

We have configured a public OAuth application with the redirect URI [Redirect URI] requesting scopes read, write, issues:create, and comments:create.

Could you please confirm:
1. Beyond toggling the application distribution to Public, are there any approval steps or verification reviews required before external workspaces can authorize and use our integration?
2. Are there any restrictions or rate limit ceilings applied to unlisted public applications prior to formal listing in the Linear Integration Directory?
3. What are the current criteria and timeline if we decide to submit [App Name] to the Linear Integration Directory in the future?

Thank you for your assistance.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
[Your Title]
[Your Company]
